integrity.scientific_claim: Exact labeled terminal law for each initial state; exact unbiased hub-reversal and consensus probabilities; two different asymptotic decay rates.

scientific_limitations: Only simple friendship graphs with equal-rate random sequential updates, open-neighborhood strict majority and current-state retention on ties.
Full absorption-time distribution, asymmetric update rates and random tie-flipping are not claimed.
Historical priority in poorly indexed sources remains uncertain.
title: Exact absorption kernel and square-root hub loyalty in asynchronous friendship-graph majority dynamics
